{{Short description|Canadian wildlife biologist}}
'''Holly Hogan''' is a Canadian wildlife biologist and writer based in [[St. John's, Newfoundland and Labrador|St. John's]], [[Newfoundland and Labrador]], whose work is centred around documenting and mitigating the consequences of plastic pollution in our oceans.

== Published work ==
Her book ''Message in a Bottle: Ocean Dispatches from a Seabird Biologist'', published in 2023, focuses on a troubling pattern spotted on her voyages across the world's seas: plastic pollution. Combining nature, science and adventure writing, Hogan puts the spotlight on the impact of plastic waste, providing an eyewitness account of its effects on the marine environment and highlighting international efforts to reduce plastic disposal in the ocean.

''Message in a Bottle'' won the 2023 BMO [[Winterset Award]],<ref>Arlette Lazarenko, [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/newfoundland-labrador/winterset-award-hogan-1.7144130 "Holly Hogan wins N.L. literary award with book about her voyages at sea"]. [[CBC News]] Newfoundland and Labrador, March 14, 2024.</ref> was a finalist for the [[Governor General's Award]] for [[Governor General's Award for English language non-fiction|English-language non-fiction]] at the [[2023 Governor General's Awards]],<ref>{{Cite news |title=Suzette Mayr, Iain Reid among finalists for Governor General's Literary Awards |url=https://www.burnabynow.com/the-mix/suzette-mayr-iain-reid-among-finalists-for-governor-generals-literary-awards-7732654 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231029223431/https://www.burnabynow.com/the-mix/suzette-mayr-iain-reid-among-finalists-for-governor-generals-literary-awards-7732654 |archive-date=October 29, 2023 |access-date=May 1, 2026 |work=Burnaby Now |language=en}}</ref> and was shortlisted for both the 2023 Science Writers and Communicators Book Award and 2024 [[Lane Anderson Award]].

== Personal life ==
Hogan is a mother of three and lives in St. John’s, Newfoundland, with her husband, [[Michael Crummey]].<ref>Ife Alaba, [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/newfoundland-labrador/authors-holly-hogan-michael-crummey-1.7129466 "They write attention-getting books, they compete for awards ... and they're married"]. [[CBC News]] Newfoundland and Labrador, March 10, 2024.</ref>
